tools.description: Bounded wait for new events past a cursor. Read-only; safe to allow.

page_size.description: Explicit page size, required on every list; at most 512 events per page (§14.9).

max_wait_milliseconds.description: Bounded wait duration (§14.9); 60000 ms cap is a derived bound — gap note G38.

continuationToken.description: Opaque scope- and audience-bound continuation token (§14.4): it carries an authenticated cursor, endpoint incarnation, recovery epoch, filter digest, and retention semantics and is never parsed or constructed by the caller; 4096-byte visible-ASCII bound — gap note G38.

tools.name: byom_event_payload
tools.description: Fetch one event's typed payload by reference, pinned by the ledger's payload digest. Read-only; safe to allow.

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

tools.name: byom_idempotency_result
tools.description: Fetch the retained outcome for an idempotency key (never re-executes). Read-only; safe to allow.

operation.description: The original mutation's operation id (IdempotencyDomain field, §14.2).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

tools.name: byom_cursor_recover
tools.description: Recover an invalidated cursor (resume or authorized snapshot restart). Read-only; safe to allow.

continuation.description: The expired or fenced token being recovered (§14.4).
